subjects.name: Briar hook polearm
subjects.brief: A long hooked bill forged around a single ash-wood shaft; broad hooked blade with deep inner negative space, leather counterweight, diagonal resting gesture. Briarfen salvage material language; no vines hiding the metal edge.

subjects.name: Saltglass glaive
subjects.brief: A crescent of translucent smoky sea glass fitted into a forked bronze socket on a short sand-worn haft; exposed glass thickness and one pale transmission plane. Distinct from an axe or staff.

subjects.name: Bellows maul
subjects.brief: A square blackened iron striking head with one recessed bellows chamber and broad copper cheek, attached securely to a thick split-grip handle; heavy grounded diagonal, no spikes.

subjects.name: Ossuary lantern flail
subjects.brief: A hollow ribbed iron weight on three large visibly connected chain links and a short ivory handle; the hollow aperture reads before detail; no skull face or flame.

subjects.name: Furnace kite shield
subjects.brief: An asymmetrical tall black steel shield with a folded copper heat baffle down one side, deep offset notch and visibly thick lower rim; three planes, not a coat of arms.

subjects.name: Reed quiver
subjects.brief: A bent reed-and-hide bolt case with a high angled lip, three broad square bolt heads and fitted shoulder strap; dry ochre reed and dark moss leather; no bow.

subjects.name: Cinder mantle
subjects.brief: An empty heavy charcoal felt shoulder mantle hanging diagonally from one copper clasp, folded outward at one side, warm inner lining and a clear open neckline; no wearer.

subjects.name: Glassworker visor
subjects.brief: A lowered smoky glass face shield riveted to an asymmetrical copper brow frame, hinged at both visible fittings; glass edge and broad transparent plane, dark empty space behind it; no face.

subjects.name: Rootstep boots
subjects.brief: A mismatched-angle pair of tall moss leather boots, one planted and one tilted to reveal a segmented wood sole; ankle folds and actual thickness; avoid vines and generic metal greaves.

subjects.name: Choir bracers
subjects.brief: A separated pair of short ivory-and-iron forearm guards with slotted open outer plates; one face-on, one side-on with thick leather lining, not gauntlets or arms.

subjects.name: Slag belt
subjects.brief: A broad worn leather tool belt curling into a supported C gesture, one blackened hinged buckle and two fitted flat metal pouches; no coins or category-symbol motif.

subjects.name: Cistern torc
subjects.brief: An open horseshoe neck ring of patinated bronze, one widened shallow ceramic cup terminal and one tapered solid terminal; clear gap, distinct metal and pale salt glaze, not a closed medallion.

subjects.name: Root snag study
subjects.brief: One thick grounded root curls around an empty boot-shaped negative space, two thin root ends press into the floor; asymmetric inward pull and pale stress cuts; no humanoid.

subjects.name: Glass shear study
subjects.brief: Three unequal broad translucent glass blades sweep diagonally through one dusty ochre arc, clear leading edge and quiet trailing space; not a cloud of shards.

subjects.name: Bell repulse study
subjects.brief: A tilted iron handbell at the moment of a single broad ivory pressure crescent pushing outward; clear bell lip, clapper and fitted handle; no concentric target rings.

subjects.name: Furnace draft study
subjects.brief: A folded ribbon of deep red heat rising from a narrow black furnace vent and bending sharply sideways, pale orange inner plane and broad charcoal gap; no explosion or fireball.

subjects.name: Ash decoy study
subjects.brief: An EMPTY half-cloak of compacted ash disintegrates along one trailing edge, broad folded planes and a clean hollow center; no face, skull, living anatomy or confetti.

subjects.name: Rime tether study
subjects.brief: A single hooked strip of pale ice stretching between two weathered stone anchors; taper, tension and one split near the leading anchor, blue-gray shadow; not a nova or teleport ring.

subjects.name: Aster tuning fork
subjects.brief: A three-pronged bronze storm tuning fork standing in a small slate socket, unequal prong heights and one fitted wire bridge, pale gold contact tips; no lightning emblem.

subjects.name: Neris tide balance
subjects.brief: A low ceramic balance with unequal shell-shaped bowls joined by a curved bronze beam; a shallow transparent water meniscus sits in the larger bowl; aqua and dark ink.

subjects.name: Vesta coal tongs
subjects.brief: A pair of heavy open black iron tongs held above a shallow glazed ember dish; visible pivot and one restrained coral coal, no brazier tower or generic flame icon.

subjects.name: Isen stillness chime
subjects.brief: Two unequal suspended blue ceramic chime slabs fitted to a low dark wood stand, one broad pale frost plane and real suspension cords; not an ice crystal or bell.

subjects.name: Nyra witness mirror
subjects.brief: An oval smoked silver mirror tilted in a low split basalt support, one lavender reflection plane crossing an otherwise dark mirror; beveled edge and open negative space beneath; no eye emblem.

subjects.name: Aster cloud vessel
subjects.brief: A shallow lidded electrum vessel with an offset stepped lid and three broad slots, seated in a dark stone cradle; quiet warm yellow reflected planes, no lightning icon.

subjects.name: Neris current coffer
subjects.brief: A sea-worn ceramic coffer with one rounded hinged lid lifted to show a pale inner cavity and aqua glass insert; broad wet rim highlights, not a book or scroll niche.

subjects.name: Vesta ember press
subjects.brief: A compact soot-black iron screw press holding a single glowing coal behind a thick slotted copper plate; supported screw and deep recess, no ornamental flames.

subjects.name: Isen salt casket
subjects.brief: A long pale ceramic cold casket whose thick lid slides partly aside, clear dark interior and thin blue frost lip; quiet faceted planes, not a crystal lamp.

subjects.name: Nyra folded screen
subjects.brief: Three unequal folded panels of dark plum cloth framed in blackened silver, one partly open revealing a pale inner surface; tangible hinges and cloth sag; no eye symbol.

subjects.name: Aster reading desk
subjects.brief: An angled bronze observation desk with a single tilted slate and a fitted rotating pointer, one broad open triangular support, no readable writing and no generic pillar.

subjects.name: Neris footbath
subjects.brief: A low crescent-shaped stone footbath with a shallow clear aqua water plane and one worn ceramic step attached to its outside edge; solid support and no fountain jet.

subjects.name: Vesta warming bench
subjects.brief: A broad low basalt bench with a copper heat plate inset in the back and one recessed coal drawer beneath the seat; connected heavy legs, quiet coral glow, no throne.

subjects.name: Isen resting cradle
subjects.brief: A low asymmetrical pale stone cradle supporting one folded blue wool blanket, deep shadow under its curved bridge and sparse frost at the far edge; no humanoid.

subjects.name: Nyra curtain frame
subjects.brief: A low freestanding offset silver rail holding one heavy plum drape swept to one side, clear weighted hem and two unequal feet; intimate interior furnishing, not a gateway arch.

subjects.name: Aster listening alcove
subjects.brief: An intimate indoor listening recess: a stepped bronze acoustic hood bends over a single slate sitting ledge, one pale storm-gold slit light. Quiet open foreground and layered near/far planes; no combat arena or guardian.

subjects.name: Neris water table
subjects.brief: A sunken circular ceramic table filled with shallow aqua water, one pale shell-backed seat and dark reed curtain at rear; reflection shapes describe calm water. No archive books, lamp or combat arena.

subjects.name: Vesta bread stone
subjects.brief: A low warm basalt kneading slab under a copper heat canopy, one loaf-shaped plain clay votive on folded linen, a restrained ember recess at side; home-scale sanctuary, no furnace monument.

subjects.name: Isen quiet ledge
subjects.brief: A pale deep window ledge with folded blue cloth, one elongated ceramic vessel and cold light from a narrow off-center opening; broad quiet planes, no snowflake emblem or crystal lamp.

subjects.name: Nyra unseen seat
subjects.brief: An empty low stone seat partly sheltered by a heavy plum curtain folding diagonally from one fitted silver rail, one pale reflected plane and a quiet black recess. No eye icon, humanoid, guardian or gateway.
